---
title: "Neon glow and gradient fill"
description: "A high-contrast cyberpunk theme with a glowing line and a gradient area fill."
categories: [Effects]
---



Layer effects and gradient fills are first-class. A `linear_gradient()` fades
the area to transparent, `glow()` haloes the line, and `theme_cyberpunk()` sets
the near-black canvas and neon palette.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1)
area <- data.frame(x = 1:80, y = 20 + cumsum(rnorm(80, 0.05, 1)))

p <- vplot(area) |>
  mark_area(
    x = x, y = y,
    fill = linear_gradient(c("#08F7FE", "#08F7FE00"),
                           x1 = 0, y1 = 1, x2 = 0, y2 = 0)
  ) |>
  mark_line(x = x, y = y, color = "#08F7FE", effects = list(glow(size = 5))) |>
  labs(title = "Gradient fill under a neon line") |>
  theme_cyberpunk()
```
:::
